name: Olivia's Wrath — "-X/-X, where X is the number of Vampires you control" is computed
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. _normalizeWhereXIs only rewrote '+X/+X, where X is the number of …' into a per-unit 'for each' boost. '-X/-X', '+X/+0', '-0/-X' and '+X/-X' fell through, so about 50 cards either did nothing or needed X typed by hand. All sign and dimension mixes are rewritten now (the non-X half must be 0; quoted abilities are left as printed). One Vampire: the Bears get -1/-1, the Vampire is untouched.
